summary: A 20-ft L-4 lookout built in 1935 by CCC Company 531 on the Coeur d'Alene National Forest near Mullan; listed as removed or gone about 1950.

facts.design: 20-ft round native timber pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Listed as removed or gone about 1950.

staffing.status: one known staff member listed: Herbert Vance

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in.

events.note: Civilian Conservation Corps Company 531, working from Camp F-132 at Big Creek, completed a 20-ft round native timber tower with an L-4 cab
Herbert Vance listed as known staff

evidence.supports: about three miles north of Mullan, Shoshone County
on the Coeur d'Alene National Forest
built 1935 by CCC Company 531 from Camp F-132 at Big Creek; 20-ft round timber tower with an L-4 cab
evidence.quote: 1935: Company 531 at Camp F-132 (Big Creek) of the Civilian Conservation Corps completed the construction of a 20-foot round native timber tower with an L-4 cab.

evidence.supports: Herbert Vance listed as known staff for 1937
firelookout.com gives the end as 1950 and calls it gone
Idaho Fire Lookouts lists it as removed in 1950
Shoshone County listing says gone around 1950

corrections.why: Idaho Fire Lookouts, the brief's source for the 1950 entry, lists it as 'Removed / Gone'; no source for East Grouse uses 'abandoned'.

notes_for_editor: Coordinates conflict: FFLA gives 47.50544, -115.80989 and Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 47.50632, -115.78183, about 2.1 km apart. None of the three sources read gives coordinates, so the record's point is unchanged. The brief's 1950 'abandoned' is corrected to 'removed'. The 20-ft figure is read as the tower height. No source states an access level, so access is omitted. Staffing rests on one name in one source. No source describes the site today.
